AgentRunBinding.comment: The workflow-side node invocation binding. The materialized edge is wf:boundToAgent from the wf:AgentRun subject to the agt:Turn subject; agt:realizedBy is declared as the inverse reading.

wf:boundToAgent.source: wf:AgentRun -> agt:Turn binding edge, filed via emporium-ingest

RunBinding.comment: The workflow-side run binding. The materialized edge is wf:boundToAgent from the wf:Run subject to the agt:Session subject; agt:realizedBy is declared as the inverse reading.

wf:boundToAgent.source: wf:Run -> agt:Session binding edge, filed via emporium-ingest

SessionRealization.comment: The inverse reading of a run binding, declared here for faces and reasoners. Emit only one direction on the wire: wf:boundToAgent from wf:Run to agt:Session.

TurnRealization.comment: The inverse reading of a node-run binding, declared here for faces and reasoners. Emit only one direction on the wire: wf:boundToAgent from wf:AgentRun to agt:Turn.

comment: WS-7 workflow-agent binding vocabulary. A publication-only composite pack: it owl:imports wf:, references agt: by relation, and declares the binding predicate wf:boundToAgent plus inverse reading agt:realizedBy. The materialized wire edge is wf:Run/wf:AgentRun wf:boundToAgent agt:Session/agt:Turn, filed via emporium-ingest into user:rdf. This pack deliberately has no write_target.
description: Composite vocabulary for binding workflow run subjects to agent-subject Session/Turn subjects.

title: Workflow-Agent Binding Vocabulary
